title: Internal: Business Checking Account Promotion - November 2025
summary: This document covers the active business checking promotion from 11/01/2025 to 11/30/2025, directing agents to prioritize qualifying accounts in order: recommend the Sky Blue account first, then the Lime Green account, and only then other qualifying accounts. It also requires verifying the recommended account meets all customer-stated requirements.
